g.text: Clamp spring bridge, rev 2; dimensions mm; four Lee LC022D03S springs
Two vertical columns, 12 mm apart along y; each column has two springs in series.
Bridge roof underside: closed arm top +44.96.
6 x42 pins fixed4 mm into moving plunger.
Flat spring seats at roof underside44.96.
Each spacer: 8 x 6.2 x 1.2 annular washer.
Plunger block: 24 x 20 x 5, 6.0 mm pins;6.4 mm roof guides.
Mount at x294.5,y-145: outboard arm,40 mm forward of pivot; schematic not to scale.
Cheeks:33 x4 x46 at y +/-15; front has shallow tube relief. Guide pins allow11.00 mm travel.
Use an8 mm roller and5 mm plunger:13 mm stack. Arm extends5 mm beyond roller contact.
Bridge follows head: integral X/Z coupling at y+23,z+37.8; two through-bolts and ribs to the foot.
Operating foot: 101 mm down and40 mm forward of pivot; force check4.567 N ideal /4.891 N model.
Pins rise through roof:9/51 mm closed ends; a15.5deg stop limits opening, never coil bind.
